subject: Cross-marketplace DST-related ledger shift & reconciliation plan
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudseller.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sudden duplicate invoice lines around 03/08 — request help

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick heads-up: our billing ops team flagged duplicated usage lines on the AWS marketplace invoice for March 8 (invoice CS-INV-3412). We've attached the PDF and the raw metering export for the date range. The duplicates look like 1-hour shifted copies of the same usage rows (timestamps +1hr).

Key ask: can Redwood verify whether this is on the marketplace side or an ingestion issue on your end? We need the reconciliation and proposed credit by EOD next week as the payout window is this Friday.

Attachments: CS-INV-3412.pdf (PDF), metering-export-20260308.csv (CSV)

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Finance Lead, CloudSeller Inc.
sam.patel@cloudseller.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudseller.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:34:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate invoice lines around 03/08 — request help

Thanks Sam — looping in Jonas for infra/ingest triage. Marissa, see attached CSV; Sam says there are duplicated rows that look like a +1h shift. Can we: 1) confirm whether our ingestion pipeline normalized timestamps to UTC correctly for the affected marketplaces, 2) check if any upstream marketplace feed applied a local offset for regions that observed DST on 03/08, and 3) estimate scope (lines, USD impact) so we can propose a credit?

If this looks like a platform ingestion bug, we'll need a retro adjustment plan (credit memo + journal entry) and to hold the payout for the affected seller until reconciliation is complete. CCed Sam so they're in the loop on internal actions.

Karthik
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudseller.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:07:50 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate invoice lines around 03/08 — request help

Quick triage notes (initial):
- I pulled the ingest trace for 2026-03-08. Our pipeline is supposed to normalize all meter timestamps to UTC on ingest. I found a window between 01:00-02:00 UTC where a timezone normalization lambda applied an extra offset when the upstream feed included a localized timestamp field (local_ts) and marketplace region was set to "us-west-2". That produced a duplicate set of rows offset by +3600s.
- Scope: preliminary estimate from a cursory scan of the CSV = ~1,200 duplicated lines across 3 SKUs for CloudSeller; gross amount ~ $3,200 prior to tax. I'll run a full dedupe and reconciliation overnight.
- Attach: ingest-log-snippet.txt (log excerpt showing the normalization call stack and the erroneous code path).

Proposed immediate remediation:
1) Run de-dup script to produce corrected usage export and a delta report (deduped_vs_original.csv).
2) Create credit memo template for seller (use credit-memo-template.xlsx) and route to finance for sign-off.
3) Hold the March payout for invoice CS-INV-3412 pending reconciliation, or apply a temporary payable hold/adjustment in ledger to avoid double-pay.

Questions:
- Jonas: do we have automated rollback for the ingestion batch or do we need a manual reprocess?
- Naomi: finance guidance on hold vs immediate credit memo? Also VAT treatment — if VAT was applied on the original invoice, credits need tax reversal evidence.

I'll follow up with the dedupe CSV and impact numbers by COB tomorrow.

—Marissa
Marketplace Billing Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudseller.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 12:29:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate invoice lines around 03/08 — request help

Marissa — thanks for the triage. Confirming: we do not have an automated rollback for consumed ingestion batches (they get materialized to ledger). We'll need to run a reprocess that: 1) reads raw meter events for 03/08-03/09, 2) applies the corrected normalization code path (no local_ts offset), and 3) emits a delta export. That pipeline is well-understood but requires a short maintenance window (~30-45m) and a ledger migration to reconcile the changes.

Operational plan (high level):
- Friday 03/06 03:00-04:00 UTC: run reprocess on a canary seller subset (CloudSeller only) to validate the dedupe script and ledger reconcile.
- If canary passes, schedule full run for Saturday 03/07 01:00 UTC.
- Generate credit memos for net deltas and route to finance + tax for VAT reversal where required.

Naomi — tagging you for the tax/AR decision. If we issue credits after the payout window, will finance prefer a retro credit memo or immediate holdback? Also, if VAT reversal is needed, we'll need seller VAT number and tax evidence to avoid misreporting in the period close.

Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer, Ingest
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudseller.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate invoice lines around 03/08 — request help

Thanks all — finance guidance below.

Requested docs from seller (Sam):
- Confirm seller VAT/Tax ID for the entity on CS-INV-3412.
- Provide an acceptance that the attached CSV represents your ledger view and permission to issue adjustments on your behalf.
- Any downstream invoices already paid to sellers that reference CS-INV-3412 (we need to track payment chain).

Finance approach:
- Hold the payable for CS-INV-3412 starting now (temporary hold flag applied). Do not stop other unrelated payouts.
- If reprocess shows net debit to Redwood (i.e., we over-collected and must credit the seller), we'll issue a credit memo and reverse VAT on our VAT report for the period. Credit memos will use the attached credit-memo-template.xlsx.
- If seller has already remitted VAT to local tax authorities based on the original invoice, we will coordinate a VAT reversal process and provide evidence so they can file an adjustment. That requires the seller to confirm VAT remittance.

Timing: once Jonas/Marissa provide the delta (expected COB Fri 03/06 canary; full run Sat 03/07), finance can prepare the credit memo and route for approval. If urgent, we can provision a temporary manual payable adjustment to prevent double-pay this cycle.

I'll prepare the finance ticket and upload the credit template to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0Bz-example/invoice-evidence (see folder "CS-INV-3412 / DST-Delta").

Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@cloudseller.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 16:46:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Sudden duplicate invoice lines around 03/08 — request help

Sam — thanks for raising this and for the attachments. Short summary and next steps from Redwood:

1) Cause: ingest normalization edge-case around DST transitions for specific marketplace feeds produced a +1hr duplicate of a subset of meter events (we found the offending lambda and log snippet attached).
2) Immediate actions: Jonas/Marissa to run a canary reprocess tonight (03/06 UTC) to validate dedupe and produce a delta report. Finance (Naomi) has applied a temporary hold on invoice CS-INV-3412 to prevent double payout.
3) If canary results look clean, we'll run the full reprocess on Saturday 03/07 and issue credit memos for any net amounts due to CloudSeller. If VAT was charged on the original invoice, we'll coordinate tax reversal evidence and route the credit for proper VAT accounting.

ETA: canary delta by EOD 03/06; full reconciliation + credit memo prep by EOD 03/07.

Please confirm you agree with Redwood proceeding with the reprocess and that CloudSeller will provide VAT confirmation if applicable. We'll send the draft credit memo to you for sign-off before issuing.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
